Row.Text: Sumeru is one of the seven nations of Teyvat. The region is renowned for its wisdom and scholars, with the Akademiya guiding its intellectual and cultural growth. Under the watchful eye of the Dendro Archon, Nahida, Sumeru's inhabitants live in harmony with nature and knowledge.

From the grand city of Sumeru to the Great Red Sands, this civilization is a blend of ancient wisdom and modern faith. The citizens revere both Nahida and the scholars of the Akademiya, who explore the mysteries of nature and life.

Wise Nahida, Lesser Lord Kusanali, the youngest of the Archons, yet the one who wields the boundless wisdom of Irminsul. The people of Sumeru look to you for guidance, as you nurture a land of knowledge, balance, and harmony. With each new insight, you bring your nation closer to understanding the mysteries of life itself. Go forth, Archon of Wisdom! Lead your people with the gentle strength of nature and let your enemies crumble beneath the weight of their ignorance. Under your watchful gaze, may Sumeru flourish, where the seeds of knowledge blossom into the pillars of civilization.

All unique district grants extra [ICON_Tourism] tourism and triggers culture bombs. Astrology is unlocked for free, and a free Great Prophet appears after building Sanctuary of Surasthana in a city. Cities get additional tiles when settled and are provided with additional +20 loyalty.

The Dendro Archon of Sumeru, Nahida is the guardian of wisdom, protecting both the knowledge and the people of her realm. Her leadership focuses on growth through faith, culture, and a deep connection to the natural world.

Nahida cannot purchase any military and religious units outside of Aranara. Under Nahida's wisdom, citizens of Sumeru produces more [ICON_Faith] Faith, and gets 100% of [ICON_Gold] [ICON_Science] [ICON_Culture] these outputs from faith. Inspirations [ICON_CivicBoosted] and Eurekas [ICON_TechBoosted] provide 100% instead of the normal 30%.
